test.title: The world is running out of sand

paragraphs.text: Sand may seem limitless, but the kind used in construction is becoming scarce. Concrete, glass and roads all require large quantities of it, and global use has roughly tripled in the last twenty years.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Desert sand is plentiful but of little use for building. Its grains have been shaped by wind into smooth, round forms that do not lock together, so concrete made with it is weak. Builders prefer sand from rivers and beaches, whose grains are rougher.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Removing sand from rivers can cause serious damage. It changes the flow of water, increases the risk of flooding downstream and destroys the habitats of fish. In some regions, illegal digging has become so widespread that governments have banned sand mining entirely.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Engineers are looking for alternatives. Crushed rock from quarries can replace river sand in many types of concrete, and some companies grind old glass bottles into a fine powder with similar properties.
paragraphs.label: D

document.title: The world is running out of sand

items.quote: global use has roughly tripled in the last twenty years
items.prompt: Global use of sand has roughly 1 ____ over the last two decades.

explanation.en: The text says: “global use has roughly tripled in the last twenty years”. The verb keeps the text’s form — tripled.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде: «global use has roughly tripled in the last twenty years». Мәтіндегідей түрдегі етістік керек — tripled.
explanation.ru: В тексте: «global use has roughly tripled in the last twenty years». Нужен глагол в той же форме, что в тексте, — tripled.

items.quote: shaped by wind into smooth, round forms that do not lock together
items.prompt: Desert sand is poor for building because its grains are smooth and 2 ____.

explanation.en: “smooth, round forms” → round. “Smooth” is already in the sentence, and “weak” describes the concrete, not the grains.
explanation.kk: «smooth, round forms» → round. «Smooth» сөйлемде тұр. «Weak» дәнді емес, бетонды сипаттайды.
explanation.ru: «smooth, round forms» → round. «Smooth» уже стоит в предложении. «Weak» описывает бетон, а не зёрна.

items.quote: Builders prefer sand from rivers and beaches, whose grains are rougher
items.prompt: Builders prefer sand from rivers and beaches because its grains are 3 ____.

explanation.en: “whose grains are rougher” → rougher. Keep the comparative form from the text.
explanation.kk: «whose grains are rougher» → rougher. Салыстырмалы шырай түрін мәтіндегідей аламыз.
explanation.ru: «whose grains are rougher» → rougher. Форму сравнительной степени берём как в тексте.

items.quote: increases the risk of flooding downstream
items.prompt: Taking sand from rivers can increase the risk of 4 ____ further down the river.

explanation.en: Taking sand “increases the risk of flooding downstream”. “Further down the river” paraphrases “downstream”, so the gap is flooding.
explanation.kk: Құм алу «increases the risk of flooding downstream». Сөйлемдегі «further down the river» — «downstream» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы, демек бос орынға flooding жазылады.
explanation.ru: Добыча песка «increases the risk of flooding downstream». В предложении «further down the river» — пересказ «downstream», значит, в пропуск идёт flooding.

items.quote: some companies grind old glass bottles into a fine powder
items.prompt: Some companies grind old 5 ____ into a powder that can replace sand.

explanation.en: “grind old glass bottles into a fine powder” → glass bottles (“bottles” is also accepted). “Crushed rock” is a different alternative in the same sentence.
explanation.kk: «grind old glass bottles into a fine powder» → glass bottles (bottles да есептеледі). «Crushed rock» — сол сөйлемдегі басқа балама.
explanation.ru: «grind old glass bottles into a fine powder» → glass bottles (засчитывается и bottles). «Crushed rock» — другая альтернатива из того же предложения.
